title: Longevity healthcare startup Vytalyou raises ₹9 crore to expand clinic network
summary: The round values the company at approximately ₹33 crore and will fund two new Mumbai centres by year-end

contentHtml:
The round values the company at approximately ₹33 crore and will fund two new Mumbai centres by year-end

Vytalyou, a doctor-led longevity and preventive healthcare startup, has raised ₹9 crore in a pre-series A funding round from Chetan Jain of Pharma Dose and Ratan Jain of Venus Industries at a valuation of approximately ₹33 crore. The company will use the funds to expand its Mumbai network of Incremental Lifestyle Clinics.

Founded in 2025 by Molecular oncologist Dr. Chirantan Bose and Radiologist Dr. Preetesh Bhandari, Vytalyou is building a network of doctor-led longevity clinics. Its model combines predictive diagnostics with a broad range of new generation personalised preventive therapies to help push back chronic lifestyle diseases and add healthy years to life. The Mumbai expansion will take its network to three centres, including its existing facility in Powai. Vytalyou plans to expand to 10 locations across India in coming years.

The company aims to reduce the number of sick years and enable people to live healthier lives. While routine health-checks spin out conventional reports, Vytalyou’s exemplary Predictive Longevity report is aimed to identify degenerative health conditions well in advance. Thereafter a medically curated preventive and regenerative therapeutic approach is used to guide the personalised programmes.

At the core of its offering is an AI-based algorithm which defines Vytalyou’s Predictive Longevity Evaluation, assessing an individual’s health profile, biological ageing and potential areas of future risk. Doctors review the findings and use them to shape a medically supervised plan. Depending on individual needs, this may include lifestyle guidance, further assessment and therapeutic programmes focused on cellular and mitochondrial health, with follow-ups to monitor the progress.

“Our focus is on increasing healthy years of life. The AI-based algorithm is unlike any other health check that helps our doctors build a more comprehensive picture of an individual’s organ-systems and shape a personalised programme, which includes interventions focused on cellular and mitochondrial health. Once the body’s own cellular repair and regenerative mechanisms are reset, health takes a new trajectory” said Dr. Chirantan Bose, Founder, Vytalyou.

“Compounding the data generated from extensive blood work up and radiological scans, we see the human physiology at a deeper level, to begin with. Preventive therapeutics incorporate new age science of cellular repair and regeneration to target disease mechanisms at their core. This is aimed to reduce the burden of metabolic dysfunction propelling heart diseases, Diabetes, Musculo-skeletal and neurological decline which comes with ageing,” said Dr. Preetesh Bhandari, Co-founder, Vytalyou.

Vytalyou has served close to 1,000 clients since opening its first centre. According to the company, around 50% came through walk-ins and another 50% through word-of-mouth referrals. The company sees an opportunity in the fast-growing longevity-care segment and says market reviews indicate annual growth of over 30%, with some estimates exceeding 50%.
